questions.question: 윗글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F일 때, 알맞지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ③번은 드라이클리닝은 물이 아닌 기름만을 사용하므로 (T)가 아니라 (F)이다.

questions.answer: cutting a chocolate bar into small chips, mixing them with her dough
questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 아래 질문에 대한 알맞은 대답이 되도록 주어진 <조건>에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하시오.

In America, there was a famous cook, Ms. Wakefield. One day in 1938, she wanted to bake chocolate cookies. However, she didn't have enough time to melt chocolate. "Aha!" So, she cut a chocolate bar into small chips. Then, she mixed them with her dough and put the cookie dough into the oven. When Ms. Wakefield opened the oven, she found that the chips were not melted into the dough. "Oh, no!" Although the chips remained in the cookies, she was not disappointed. Her new cookies were so delicious. She invented chocolate CHIP cookies!

Q. How did Ms. Wakefield solve the problem of melting chocolate?

<조건>
(1)은 7단어, (2)는 5단어로 어법에 맞게 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: Wakefield 씨는 초콜릿 바를 작은 조각으로 잘라 반죽에 섞어서 초콜릿을 녹이는 문제를 해결했다.

The Yuhyeonggeo was a kind of cart. It _____________ _____________ _____________ Jung Yakyong in 1792. questions.question:
다음 글의 내용과 (A)~(C)가 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 쓸 때, 순서대로 연결된 것은?

In 1903, a French scientist, Mr. Bénédictus, was experimenting with liquid plastic in a glass flask. He accidentally hit the glass flask, and it fell on the floor. "Oops!" Although the glass flask was broken into pieces, they still held together in the shape of the flask! How could this happen? The secret was the liquid plastic in the flask. This finding led to his invention of safety glass. These days, we can find safety glass everywhere. For example, it is used for car windows. If there is a car accident, people are safer from sharp pieces of glass.

(A) Mr. Bénédictus wondered about the result of hitting the glass flask during the experiment. (T/F)
(B) The broken glass pieces scattered all over the floor. (T/F)
(C) Safety glass protects people from sharp pieces during an accident. (T/F)
questions.explanation: (A) 실험 중에 우연히 플라스크를 쳤으므로 F, (B) 조각들이 플라스크 모양으로 붙어 있었으므로 F, (C) 안전유리는 사고 중에 날카로운 조각으로부터 사람들을 보호하므로 T
